# RuleBlast — Git diff for AI agent repository instructions

> Git diff for AI agent repository instructions. Shows the blast radius of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md changes across Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI.

RuleBlast answers the problem query: which files inherit a changed AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md? Git shows the first diff. RuleBlast shows the second.

- Repository: https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ruleblast
- Landing: https://kpoiut.github.io/ruleblast/
- Problem page: https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast/blob/main/which-files-inherit-agents-md.md
- Sealed case: 2 instruction-line edits → 206 Codex stacks — https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast/blob/main/PROOF.md
- CLI: npx --yes ruleblast@2.4.6 .
- This tree is 2.4.9. Published CLI is ruleblast@2.4.6. Human diff adds OTHER TRACKED CHANGES, CHANGE ALIGNMENT, INTENT, and a WORK MAP. Default text is the summary; --detail prints the same result in full. The same result can print --paths-only, explain --compare, and a PROOF line. Which files now inherit different AI instructions?

Local. Read-only. Deterministic. Not a claim about model compliance.
